content.thinking: Good — the S==0 branch was already removed in my rewrite. Let me patch lines 495-502.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
src = open('planner.py').read()
old = """        if best < wdist[j]:
            wdist[j] = best
            parent[wj] = bestarc
            dist[wj] = best
            changed = True
        else:
            dist[wj] = wdist[j]
    return changed"""
new = """        if best < wdist[j]:
            wdist[j] = best
            parent[wj] = bestarc
            changed = True
        elif bestarc >= 0 and parent[wj] < 0:
            parent[wj] = bestarc
        dist[wj] = wdist[j]
    return changed"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('planner.py','w').write(src)
print('ok')
PYEOF
